speaker: james
text: Mr. Holmes, sir. A dreadful business. Her Ladyship is quite beside herself. I shall help in any way I can.

speaker: james
text: I must decline to say anything further, sir. I should like to speak to Her Ladyship's solicitor.

speaker: james
text: If that is all, sir, I have duties to attend to.

speaker: james
text: I assure you, sir, I would rather not say.

speaker: holmes
text: A moneylender's letter, and not addressed to the master of the house.

speaker: holmes
text: Two keys, Watson. One in Her Ladyship's purse. The other hangs in the butler's pantry.

speaker: holmes
text: The new maid, seen near the study at nine. Interesting, though perhaps not as interesting as it appears.

speaker: holmes
text: Saturday night, in Mayfair. Lady Mary Ashford gave a dinner party for twelve.

speaker: holmes
text: Her butler, James, served every course himself. Or so he tells us.

speaker: holmes
text: Upstairs, her study stayed locked all evening. By midnight, her blue necklace was gone.

speaker: holmes
text: Twenty years of loyal service. A man of perfect manners, with one great weakness: his son, Peter.

speaker: holmes
text: Of late, young Peter has fallen in with dangerous company. His father has not slept well since.

speaker: holmes
text: Tonight, James sits across my desk at Baker Street. Let us see what he is hiding.
